about.title: About | RecRoc
about.description: RecRoc is a hybrid production company and creative agency in North Dakota, led by filmmakers, DJs and composers.
headline: People
who
genuinely
care.
about.sub: Decide for yourself whether our values line up with what you need. If we were the client, we would want a team that cares about the exact service we are buying.
body: Our production teams are made of people who understand the craft behind the work. The filmmakers have contributed to professional movie productions. The DJs are performing artists with advanced mixing skills, live mash-ups, scratching, and EDM festival level sets behind them.

We work with local businesses, corporations, organisations and artists. Launching a brand, promoting an organisation, producing an event, making something for an audience: the job is to get your idea into a finished piece without the usual friction.
The work goes past the client list. We want local businesses and organisations to grow, because that strengthens the communities and creates opportunities in the cities we work in.
about.mission: RecRoc exists to help businesses and organisations build media identities that strengthen their reputation, earn trust, and drive profitable growth.

why.d: Instead of putting account managers between you and the production team, you work with the people who understand the cameras, the computers, the scripts, the music. Led by filmmakers, DJs and composers who know their craft firsthand.

Your project gets its own identity, built around your goals, your audience, and what makes your organisation different. Fresh thinking on every brief, whether it is a brand, a commercial, an event or something we have not built before.

We take the time to understand what you need, communicate clearly through the process, deliver on time, and take responsibility for the quality of what we produce. The goal is not to complete your project. It is to make something that holds up.

values.d: We do not settle for soulless work when we have the ability to make something meaningful.
Great work starts with great people. Relationships built on respect, trust, communication and genuine care. Clients supported, creators valued, employees given room to do their best work.
Our success is tied to the success of the people we work with. When clients grow, RecRoc grows. The people who build RecRoc grow with it.

Knowledge should not be hidden and opportunity should not be reserved for people who already have the connections. Ask questions, learn from each other, take on new roles. Effort and talent still decide, but everyone deserves the chance to find their path.

process.title: Our Process | RecRoc
process.description: Five steps from first conversation to final delivery. Organised, efficient, and built to keep your project moving.
headline: Simple
from
start
to
finish.
process.sub: From the first conversation to final delivery, every step is organised, efficient, and built to make the experience as smooth as possible.

steps.d: We start by listening. Every project begins with understanding your goals, your ideas and your expectations, so the creative direction gets built with you rather than handed to you.
Once we understand the vision, we write a clear plan before production begins. Everyone stays aligned, nobody guesses, and the project keeps moving.
Production. Our team handles it with attention to detail, making sure every shot, every sound and every design decision is doing a job.
The most important part. We review every detail, then you review the project and request revisions. Delivering exactly what you asked for is the priority, so this stage takes as long as it takes.
Once approved, your project arrives in high quality formats, ready for websites, social media, advertising, print, or wherever you need it.

globalFaqs.a: Yes. We work throughout North Dakota, nationwide and internationally. Travel and accommodation costs are discussed openly during planning, never added afterwards.

globalFaqs.q: Do you use stock or AI generated music?
globalFaqs.a: No. Subscription libraries and AI tracks mean the same music can end up behind your competitor's advert. Every score we deliver is composed by a human, exclusively for the project.

globalFaqs.q: Who will I actually be working with?
globalFaqs.a: The people making the work. No account managers sitting between you and the production team, which means fewer translation errors and faster decisions.
Yes. Our pilots are FAA Part 107 certified and fly everything from compact cinematic drones to larger professional platforms, wherever conditions and local regulations allow.

globalFaqs.q: Can you work with our event or AV team?
globalFaqs.a: Regularly. We coordinate with event planners, venue staff, audio engineers, lighting technicians and production crews so coverage runs without disrupting the event.

Photography and DJ bookings can move quickly. Video projects usually run two to six weeks depending on complexity and revision rounds. Tell us your date and we will tell you honestly whether it is achievable.
